cases.description: Color, jacket type, size and a "10 hazaar tak" budget, in Hinglish.

turns.user: Black leather jacket dikhao, XL size, 10 hazaar tak
turns.reply: Monsoonwear sabse zyada garam aur best-rated hai (men's), jabki Snowline wale halke hain; dhyan rahe ki ₹8,049 wala Snowline women's fit hai. Inme se koi bhi waterproof nahi hai.

cases.description: Two numeric attributes and a budget range written as "between 25k and 40k".

turns.user: Phone with 12 GB RAM and 256 GB storage, between 25k and 40k
turns.reply: Vyom Zen is the best all-rounder here, with the top rating, a big battery and a 64 MP camera. Pick Novaphone Nova if you want the 108 MP camera, or Pixelon Zen if you want the biggest screen.

cases.description: A numeric range ("between 30 and 40 litres") and a boolean, with no budget.

turns.user: Waterproof travel backpack between 30 and 40 litres
turns.reply: I found 13 matches. The Packwise Ascent 35 L is a strong value pick with a laptop compartment. If you don't need laptop space, look at the Packwise Explorer 38 L or the TrailCarry Nova 32 L.

cases.description: Fabric, gender and size with a range written as "between 1k and 2.5k".

turns.user: Men's linen kurta in XL, between 1k and 2.5k
turns.reply: The Rangsutra Saanjh is a solid office pick and comes with lots of reviews. For daily wear, the Mehfil Noor and DesiLoom three-quarter sleeve options are well rated, and the Utsav and Rangsutra Aangan have short sleeves for hot days.

cases.description: An appliance type with a minimum warranty and a "₹2,000" budget.

turns.user: electric kettle with at least 2 years warranty, under ₹2,000
turns.reply: The Annapurna Prime at ₹959 is the standout: it has a 5-year warranty and high ratings, and it's one of the cheapest here. If you need a bigger kettle for the family, the Homeline Neo holds 1.8 L and comes with a 3-year warranty.

cases.description: A stated laptop use and screen size with a budget written as "1 lakh".

turns.user: Business laptop with a 14 inch screen, under 1 lakh
turns.reply: The Aeon Blade gives you a high-tier CPU and 16GB RAM at a low price. The Lumen Studio has the best reviews but only 8GB RAM, and the Aeon Air is the lightest pick if you travel a lot.

cases.description: "Bag" with a laptop compartment is a backpack, and "Rs 2500 tak" is the budget.

turns.user: Kaam pe roz laptop le jaata hoon, laptop compartment wala bag chahiye, Rs 2500 tak
turns.reply: Roz ke commute ke liye Commuto Ascent sabse badhiya hai, kyunki ye waterproof hai aur iski rating bhi sabse achhi hai. Kam budget mein UrbanSling Explorer bhi waterproof hai.

cases.description: A terse request with a brand, a color, a type and a bare size number.

turns.user: StrideX formal shoes, grey, size 11
turns.reply: The Glide has the most reviews and the best rating, and the Terra is the cheapest pick with a good rating. The Breeze costs the most but has fewer reviews and a lower rating.

cases.description: Gender, fabric, sleeve and size, in Hinglish.

turns.user: Ladies ke liye cotton kurta, three-quarter sleeve, L size
turns.reply: Daily wear ke liye Utsav Classic (₹399) value pick hai, office ke liye Kalakriti Noor sabse zyada reviewed hai, aur festive look chahiye toh Kalakriti Saanjh dekhiye.

cases.description: A camera resolution and a boolean, with no budget.

turns.user: A 5G phone with a 200MP camera
turns.reply: The Kirin Orbit has the best rating and is well below its MRP, and the Vyom Nova has the biggest battery and screen. If you're on a tight budget, the Kirin Zen and Aurora Spark both have the 200MP camera for much less.

cases.description: A use case with a stated jacket type, a size and a "₹3,500" budget.

turns.user: Heading to Goa in July, need a rain jacket in M, budget ₹3,500
turns.reply: All of these are waterproof and come in M. The list mixes men's and women's styles, so check the gender on each card. Goa in July is hot and humid, so the lighter ones are a good pick, like UrbanLayer Summit (women's) or Monsoonwear Pamir (men's).

cases.description: "Ghadi" is a watch; an analog type for a parent with "8000 tak" (enough results even if gender men is inferred).

turns.user: Papa ke liye analog ghadi chahiye, 8000 tak
turns.reply: Vela Active ki rating sabse achhi hai, aur Vela Pulse metal strap mein classic look deti hai. Agar papa ko formal leather strap pasand hai to Horizon Active dekhiye, bas iski rating thodi kam hai.

cases.description: A numeric minimum ("16 GB RAM or more") with a plain "under 70000" budget.

turns.user: Need 16 GB RAM or more in a coding laptop, under 70000
turns.reply: For coding I put the high-tier CPU options first: the Vertex Blade is the lightest, and the Aeon Blade Business has more storage. If you want to spend less, the Corebook Studio at the end is the cheapest 16 GB pick, but it has an entry CPU and is heavy.

cases.description: Shoe type, gender (unisex also fits), a UK size and a "12k max" budget.

turns.user: running shoes for women, UK 6, 12k max
turns.reply: The two UrbanStep pairs at the top have the highest ratings. If you want something cheaper that's still well rated, the Footcraft Classic is a strong pick.

cases.description: "Lower priced ones" (cheaper, no number) keeps the fabric and gender; the new budget depends on what was shown.

turns.user: Silk kurta for women, for Karva Chauth
turns.reply: For a classic Karva Chauth look, the DesiLoom Heritage comes in red and the Taana Classic in maroon. The DesiLoom Noor is the top-rated pick but only comes in sizes S to L.

turns.user: too pricey, show lower priced ones
turns.reply: This is the only silk festive kurta cheaper than the ones I showed you. It only comes in gold, and size M isn't available.

cases.description: Narrowing to two brands keeps the smartwatch type and budget.

turns.user: Smartwatch under 8k
turns.reply: The Meridian Heritage is the top-rated pick, and the Kaal Classic gives strong ratings for a lot less. If you swim, look at the 100m water-resistant ones like the Tempo Heritage (men's) or the Meridian Pulse.

turns.user: only Vela or Tempo please
turns.reply: The Vela Orbit is the standout, with top ratings and 100m water resistance at a low price, though it's a women's model. For a unisex option, the Tempo Luxe is the pick, and the Tempo Heritage (grey/yellow) is a budget men's choice.

cases.description: "Teesre wale" is the third shown. By rating, the third induction cooktop is an Annapurna; the follow-up asks for the brand.

turns.user: Show me the top 3 rated induction cooktops
turns.reply: The Kitchenmate has the top rating and the longest warranty. The two Swaad and Annapurna cooktops cost less and have more power, but the Annapurna only comes with a 1-year warranty.

turns.user: teesre wale ka brand aur details batao
turns.reply: Teesra cooktop Annapurna brand ka Annapurna Neo Induction Cooktop hai, jo ₹2,279 ka hai (MRP ₹2,681), 2021 W power ke saath aur yellow ya grey color mein milta hai. Iski rating 4.7 hai (6,776 reviews), lekin warranty sirf 1 saal ki hai.

cases.description: Adding a storage minimum keeps the laptop budget.

turns.user: Student laptop under 45k
turns.reply: The Aeon Air is the best all-rounder: it's light, has a mid-tier CPU and the best rating, but only 256GB of storage. The Corebook Blade gives you 16GB RAM and 512GB at a reasonable weight, and the Corebook Studio is the cheapest with 16GB RAM, though it's heavy.

turns.user: make it 512 GB storage or more
turns.reply: The Stratos Blade is the standout value: a mid-tier CPU, 16GB RAM and very light, at a lower price than most here. The Quanta Studio (13.3-inch) offers similar specs with a stronger rating track record, while the Lumen Studio is top-rated if you want a bigger 15.6-inch screen.

cases.description: Adding a color keeps the jacket type, size and budget.

turns.user: Fleece jacket, size S, under 4k
turns.reply: The UrbanLayer Pamir is a strong value pick: high warmth, light, unisex, and well rated. Check the gender on each card, because some of these are cut for men or women only.

turns.user: show only grey ones
turns.reply: The two Himfrost jackets are the safest picks: the Glacier is warmer but cut for men, and the Ridge is lighter and unisex. The Snowline Pamir is the cheapest and is a women's fit.

cases.description: Adding a boolean in Hinglish keeps the backpack budget.

turns.user: Laptop backpack 2000 tak dikhao
turns.reply: Commuto Ascent waterproof hai aur sabse zyada rated hai. Kam budget mein Packwise Ridge bhi waterproof hai aur value ke liye achha option hai.

turns.user: sirf waterproof wale
turns.reply: Commuto Ascent sabse zyada rated hai, lekin NomadGear Ascent aur Packwise Ridge kam price mein bade 32 L capacity wale achhe options hain.

cases.description: Comparing the 1st and 3rd of the cheapest digital watches, a Chronex and a Vela; the follow-up asks for the brand.

turns.user: Cheapest 3 digital watches you have?
turns.reply: The Chronex Luxe is the cheapest and has the best rating of the three, but it's a women's model. If you want a unisex watch, the Chronex Heritage is the only one here, and it has a metal strap.

turns.user: Which brands are the 1st and 3rd, and how do they differ?
turns.reply: The 1st is from Chronex (Chronex Luxe) and the 3rd is from Vela (Vela Heritage), and both are women's watches with silicone straps. The Chronex costs less (₹969 vs ₹1,149), is rated higher (4.2 vs 3.9) and is water resistant to 100 m instead of 30 m, but it only comes in yellow, while the Vela also comes in pink, blue and silver.

cases.description: "Laptop number 3" of the 3 cheapest 16 GB laptops is a Vertex; the user asks for its brand.

turns.user: The 3 cheapest laptops with 16GB RAM please
turns.reply: The Stratos Pro costs a little more than the Corebook but has a mid-tier CPU and is much lighter. The Vertex Pro is the only one of the three with just 256GB of storage.

turns.user: What's the screen size on laptop number 3, and which brand is it?
turns.reply: Laptop number 3 is the Vertex Pro Student Laptop, made by Vertex, and its screen is 15.6 inches. Want me to show other 16GB RAM laptops with the same screen size?

cases.description: "Upar wali pehli" is the cheapest denim jacket, a Snowline; the follow-up asks for the brand.

turns.user: Denim jacket chahiye, sabse kam price wale 3 dikhao
turns.reply: Snowline sabse sasta hai, par UrbanLayer ki rating sabse achhi hai. Dhyan dein: Snowline men's ke liye hai, AltiGear unisex hai aur UrbanLayer women's ke liye.

turns.user: Upar wali pehli jacket kis brand ki hai, aur kitni bhaari hai?
turns.reply: Pehli jacket, Snowline Pamir Denim Jacket, Snowline brand ki hai. Iska weight 859 g hai.

cases.description: A question about the most expensive gaming laptop, a Corebook; the follow-up asks for the brand.

turns.user: Show me your 3 priciest gaming laptops
turns.reply: These are our top three by price among in-stock gaming laptops, and all three are close in cost. The Vertex Edge has the most RAM and storage of the three, and the Vertex Pro is the best rated.

turns.user: Which brand is the first one, and how heavy is it?
turns.reply: The first one, the Corebook Edge Gaming Laptop, is made by Corebook and weighs 2.7 kg.

cases.description: A question about the third of the cheapest waterproof shoes, a MonsoonGrip; the follow-up asks for the brand.

turns.user: Show me the 3 cheapest waterproof shoes
turns.reply: The cheapest waterproof options are all sandals. The PaceOne Terra is a women's style and the other two are unisex. If you want closed shoes, I can show waterproof sneakers or trekking shoes instead.

turns.user: Which brand is pair number 3, and which sole does it have?
turns.reply: Pair number 3 is the MonsoonGrip Breeze Sandals, made by MonsoonGrip. It has an EVA sole.

cases.description: A question about the third of the top-rated phones under a budget, a Vyom; the follow-up asks for the brand.

turns.user: Top 3 highest rated phones under 20k
turns.reply: All three are rated 4.9. The Aurora Pulse is the only one with 5G and has by far the most reviews, so it's the safest choice. The Aurora Spark is the cheapest of the three and has a 200 MP camera.

turns.user: Which brand is the 3rd phone, and does it support 5G?
turns.reply: The 3rd phone, the Vyom Neo Phone (4 GB RAM, 64 GB), is made by Vyom, and it doesn't support 5G. If you want 5G, the Aurora Pulse (1st card) has it and has the same 4.9 rating.

cases.description: A question about the third of the most expensive kurtas, a Mehfil; the follow-up asks for the brand.

turns.user: What are your 3 most expensive kurtas?
turns.reply: All three are silk wedding kurtas and are priced very close together. The Rangsutra has the top rating and comes in all sizes, while the Taana women's kurta comes only in S, L and XXL.

turns.user: Which brand is the kurta in third place, and which sizes is it available in?
turns.reply: The third kurta, the Mehfil Heritage Silk Kurta for Men, is from Mehfil. It's available in sizes M, XL and XXL.

cases.description: Comparing the 1st and 3rd of the cheapest 5G phones, a Pixelon and a Novaphone; the follow-up asks for the brand.

turns.user: Sabse saste 3 5G phones dikhao
turns.reply: Pixelon Neo sabse sasta hai aur 256 GB storage deta hai. Kirin Neo ki rating sabse achhi hai aur battery bhi badi hai.

turns.user: Pehla aur teesra kis brand ke hain, aur unme kya fark hai?
turns.reply: Pehla phone Pixelon (Pixelon Neo, ₹10,019) ka hai aur teesra Novaphone (Novaphone Orbit, ₹10,859) ka. Dono mein 6 GB RAM aur 256 GB storage hai, lekin Pixelon sasta hai aur usmein 48 MP camera aur 4794 mAh battery hai, jabki Novaphone mein 12 MP camera, 4651 mAh battery aur badi 6.5 inch screen hai.

cases.description: No down jacket in M is under ₹4,600 even after the 15% raise; dropping the size finds some.
